claims: The 98th Academy Awards (Oscars) are taking place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony is held at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony begins at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.
Red carpet coverage for the 98th Academy Awards starts at 3:30 p.m. ET/12:30 p.m. PT.
Red carpet coverage for the 98th Academy Awards is on ABC and Hulu.
The 98th Academy Awards airs live on ABC.
The 98th Academy Awards is available for streaming on Hulu and ABC App.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony will be hosted by Conan O'Brien.
